meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: MUST USE for planning before coding when design uncertainty remains after discovery: ambiguous scope, competing decompositions, unclear boundaries, uncertain dependency ordering, architecture decisions, a vague 'just make it good / figure out what to build' brief, or any request to plan, interview, or break work down. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode, just make it good, figure out what to build.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编码前制定完整的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需求模糊或架构不确定，需要先规划再编码。
copy.tagline_en: Create a complete development plan before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan before coding when requirements are unclear or architecture is uncertain.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先探索代码库，只问无法通过探索解决的问题，然后等你批准，再写出一份完整的、无需再问问题的工作计划。
howto.when: 当你说“做个计划”、“规划一下”、“采访我”等，或要求规划、分解任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一下这个新功能怎么做。
say.note: Claude 会开始探索并询问关键问题。
Claude 会主动提问，收集信息后制定计划。

say.text: 把用户登录模块的改进方案规划出来。
say.note: Claude 会针对该模块进行探索和规划。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first explores the codebase, asks only questions that exploration cannot resolve, waits for your approval, then writes a single decision-complete work plan that requires no further interview.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'plan this', 'make a plan', 'interview me', 'break this down', or any request to plan or decompose work.

say_en.text: Plan this new feature for me.
say_en.note: Claude will start exploring and ask key questions.

say_en.text: Interview me and write a plan.
say_en.note: Claude will ask questions, then create a plan.

say_en.text: Plan the improvement for the login module.
say_en.note: Claude will explore and plan for that module.
